answer: A stake-bonded registry makes each agent lock a refundable deposit before it can trade. Forging a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits, so the attack's cost scales linearly, like hauling supplies across a tundra where every extra mile burns real fuel. Peer attestations and slashing form a canyon of verification: a caught fake forfeits its deposit, leaving its balance umber with loss, so Sybils pay more than they can ever earn back.
